spawn.description: Template shortcut: spawn this when the quest is accepted (e.g. the bounty target).

thanks.description: Thank-you line for the end stage.

assured.description: search: succeed anyway once a player's tries are spent, so a required clue can't block the quest (default true).

dc.description: A number, or leave out and give `difficulty`.

difficulty.description: easy (10), moderate (15), hard (20) or veryhard (25), instead of dc.

else.description: What a failed check leads to: "fight" (the NPC turns hostile; a kill stage can still finish it), "end" (nothing).

skill.description: One of skill, ability (str/dex/con/int/wis/cha) or save (fort/reflex/will); a search stage takes a skill only.

StageExamine.description: search: a second check rolled on success by whoever in the party is best at it (e.g. Lore on a found letter's seal).

var.description: Module local string set to "1" on a pass (readable with q_chk var=).

StageInput.description: A stage as the model writes it (only `do` and `journal` are needed for most kinds).

approach.description: Stage 1: the giver walks up to the first player it sees and starts its conversation; a string is a bark as it goes.

area.description: Area for explore/trigger stages, for placing an unplaced kill target, and an escort's destination.

companion.description: Talk stage: only offered while this companion (tag) is in the party.

dismiss.description: Talk stage: this companion (tag) leaves the party when the stage advances and goes to the NPC.

from_creature.description: Where a pickup item is: in this creature's inventory (it drops on death) or this placeable's.

item.description: Item: picked up (pickup) or handed over (deliver), by resref; `itemName` creates a new quest item.

join.description: The NPC running this talk stage joins the speaker's party as a henchman when it advances.

keep.description: deliver: the NPC looks at the item but the party keeps it.

none.description: search: text when the placeable is used before the quest reaches this stage.

offer.description: Dialog lines (all optional; defaults are used).

optional.description: search: an optional clue, not a numbered stage — no journal entry, doesn't move the quest on; available once the quest is at or past `from` (default 1); pays its `reward` to the party once.

script.description: Script run on the advancing object (the NPC) when the stage advances (questK_self_script).

spawn.description: Creature(s) that appear when this stage's line advances the quest.

target.description: Kill target, captive, escorted NPC, or placeable to use (tag or blueprint resref).

to.description: NPC who runs a talk/deliver stage (tag or blueprint resref); default the giver.

xp.description: Flat XP per player (exact; used by /adventure-rewards), in addition to or instead of a tier.

StageSpawn.description: A creature that appears when this stage advances the quest (stage 1 = when the quest is accepted): a bounty target in an area the party has already explored, an ambush, guards, the next part of a multi-part encounter. On a dialog stage it rides on the q_act line; on a kill/pickup/explore/trigger/use/search stage it is written as the slot's questK_spawn locals. A kill stage whose target is this resref or tag needs no placed copy.

area.description: Otherwise: an area (and optionally x,y) where the builder places a waypoint itself, on walkable ground.

at.description: Tag of an existing waypoint to appear at.

flag.description: The outcome of an earlier part changes this one: a module variable (set by a dialog line's `set_var`, e.g. "alarm" raised when the lookout got away) picks the count. `ifSet` is the count when the variable is set (non-empty, not "0"); `ifUnset` when it is not. A count of 0 skips the spawn (the patrol never arrives). Counts are 0-8.

tag.description: Instance tag (default: the blueprint's own). Lets several quests reuse one blueprint.
